newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up in thin trad.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up in thin trad.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed slightly up by 0.27 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 588.87 from 587.31 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 120,000 dinars against 5.5 million dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix was up 0.9 dinar to 34 dinars.
Arab Tunisian Bank eased 1.76 dinar to 56.9 dinars.
